title: Pricey items
prompt:
A list of baskets holds prices: each basket is a list of numbers, such as `[[2, 9], [], [12]]`.

Write a function `count_pricey(baskets, limit)` that returns how many prices in all baskets are strictly greater than `limit`. Use a loop inside a loop.

For example, `count_pricey([[2, 9], [], [12]], 5)` returns `2`.
hints: The outer loop gives you one basket at a time; each basket is itself a list you can loop over.
Put an `if price > limit:` inside the inner loop and add 1 to a counter.
Make sure `count = 0` is set once, before both loops.
